verdict.rationale: Pomelo's API documents card creation, digital accounts with activity data, transaction handling and merchant/category blocking, so an agent could in principle drive the card program through the API. However, the official MCP server only searches endpoints and generates code samples; it does not perform operational actions. Nothing documents scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents, and card updates and balance reads are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: operational MCP tools (read balances and transactions, create and update cards, adjust controls), scoped credentials for agent access, explicit card-update and balance-read endpoints, a published API spec, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate my card program — read balances and transactions, create and update cards, and adjust spend controls through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials
